products.title: Mount Dominance by Brandon McCaghren
products.body:
Develop a More Dominant Mount and Learn The “Musts” of The No Gi Top Game Featuring 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor, Brandon McCaghren
  • Brandon McCaghren is a black belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most acclaimed instructors, staking his claim as the first 10P instructor in the Southeastern United States
  • Take an unorthodox approach to some classic jiu-jitsu themes, and revolutionize the way you attack from one of BJJ’s most underutilized positions, all with a 10th Planet Black Belt at the helm
  • The mount is an entirely different animal in no gi and we must adapt our games to reflect these major differences so we can still dominate from this important position
  • Learn superior body positioning tactics that you’ve never seen before so you can transform your no gi mount game from average to extraordinary
  • Explore a densely packed instructional that includes positional guidance, tons of submissions, finishing mechanics, mount maintenance strategies, and more all with the added 10th Planet flare that you’ll only get from a seasoned 10P black belt
  • Discover the spiderweb, the mounted rubber guard sugar hold, the punch choke, mounted triangle gold, multiple back takes, the chopping block, and more, all with exquisite details and guidance you won’t find anywhere else

products.title: Kimura Control by Kyle Boehm
products.body:
Master The 10th Planet Kimura System - The 10th Planet Specialty That Requires Zero Flexibility To Work From Top Or Bottom

  • Learn how you can control and tap people with the kimura from BJJ Fanatics Invitational Champion & 10th Planet Instructor Kyle Boehm
  • Kyle shows all of his favorite ways to get the kimura, and what he does when he’s there to finish fights at the elite level
  • Kyle is the winner of the BJJ Fanatics Invitational brown and black belt tournaments
  • With innovative and creative entries from top, bottom, and standing, find your way to some of 10th-Planet’s best positions

Master The 10th Planet Kimura System - The 10th Planet Specialty That Requires Zero Flexibility To Work From Top Or Bottom

Learn how you can control and tap people with the kimura from BJJ Fanatics Invitational Champion & 10th Planet Instructor Kyle Boehm


Ashi Entry From Collar Tie:

What Will You Learn?

Learn the rock-solid 10th-Planet kimura system from Eddie Bravo black belt and instructor Kyle Boehm, the winner of the inaugural BJJ Fanatics submission-only tournament. Attack the tap and lock them down with these out of this world combinations and finishes to all of 10th-Planet’s signature positions. Kyle shows all of his favorite ways to get the kimura, and what he does when he’s there to finish fights at the elite level. Now you can use one of grappling’s most important holds with the secrets from 10th Planet, from two-time BJJ Fanatics champion Kyle Boehm.

Kyle Boehm put himself on the map with a big win at the submission-only open weight tournament that we held, beating some super tough fighters to bring home the gold. Then, he got promoted to black belt and won our black belt tournament too!!! In a bracket with great fighters like Hulk Barbosa, Nicky Rod, and more, Kyle emerged as the champion. What impressed everyone the most as not just how aggressive Kyle was about looking for submissions, but also how technical he was in all of his positions and escapes. Now, you can learn his specialties, including the killer double wrist lock kimura series that is his best stuff.

With innovative and creative entries from top, bottom, and standing, find your way to some of 10th-Planet’s best positions and systematically work for the victory. Transition to spider-web control, dynamic back takes, and more with Kyle’s technical coaching, full of the little details that make this system unique to him and his team. Get this elite competitor’s blueprint to success with this step-by-step manual on how to control anyone with the kimura.

This is a submission series that is proven to work on our own BJJ Fanatics mats, and we are so excited for Kyle to be sharing his details for success with everyone. These moves don’t take any of 10th-Planet’s famous flexibility to work, they can be used by anyone (even against grapplers much bigger and stronger). Combine these powerful attacks with Kyle’s favorite ways to finish fights and give yourself a go-to lock that works on everyone.

products.title: Guard Master: How To guard Them All by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Attack Relentlessly From Your Back With 10th-Planet Black Belt & Elite Competitor Geo Martinez’s Creative & Effective System For No-Gi Guard Play
  • Use the no-gi guard to take the back, sweep on top, and get to submission locks, all supercharged with Geo’s 10th Planet creativity
  • Fight with a De La X guard, Geo’s Butter Half, reverse De La Riva, and more for multiple opportunities to attack
  • Get an inside look at the 10th-Planet guard that Geo has learned and innovated on to create this unique system
  • You don’t need crazy flexibility or speed to do any of these moves, Geo shows you how he teaches his students to use these techniques at any level
  • Geo Martinez is one of the most prominent and successful 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belts, with his own school and incredible success against elite compeition

Learn Classic 10th Planet Positions And Attacks Like The Lock Down, De La X, Homie Control, And More!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

The no-gi guard continues to evolve and Geo Martinez has been on the forefront of that movement with his creative and effective work from his back. Now is your chance to learn from this elite competitor and 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belt instructor as Geo shows you all the techniques and strategies you can use for guard success on this 4-volume series.

Fight from your back with details on some of Geo’s best guards, including De La X, reverse De La Riva, spiral guard, and more. Combine these highly effective positions with Geo’s advice on getting the most leverage possible, including some of his favorite combinations for competition.

Geo shows you the butter half guard that he has developed over the year for incredible offensive output. With only a few modifications to classic half, you can begin attacking with kimuras, guillotines, lockdowns, and more. This half guard system is a great position for grapplers of all ages to slow down the fight and attack on their own terms.

Geo Martinez is one of 10th Planet’s premier black belts, with an incredible competition career that includes multiple ADCC appearances and EBI Championships. His system that he teaches is safe, effective, and useful for grapplers of all ages - no crazy athleticism or flexibility necessary.

products.title: Knee Tap Series by Sam Schwartzapfel
products.body:
Sam Schwartzapfel is a high level brown belt under Eddie Bravo and has an interesting take on BJJ. After being hit by a car and suffering a myriad of substantial injuries, he had to come back to the sport he loved most and find ways to safely simplify his movement

  • Sam was able to create a unique and effective system of BJJ post injury that has an emphasis on detailed technique and efficient application.
  • Sam's knee tap series is one of a kind and takes the infamous 10th planet bjj approach but makes it easy to digest
  • A lot of people are intimidated by learning 10th planet techniques that are not part of the system under the assumption that they are complex, difficult or require dexterity.
  • Sam's knee tap series is here to change your perspective. This one of a kind series has it all! Takedowns, submissions, and so much more!



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Sam Schwartzapfel is a high level brown belt under Eddie Bravo and has an interesting take on BJJ. After being hit by a car and suffering a myriad of substantial injuries, he had to come back to the sport he loved most and find ways to safely simplify his movement. Sam was able to create a unique and effective system of BJJ post injury that has an emphasis on detailed technique and efficient application.

Sam's knee tap series is one of a kind and takes the infamous 10th planet bjj approach but makes it easy to digest. A lot of people are intimidated by learning 10th planet techniques that are not part of the system under the assumption that they are complex, difficult or require dexterity. Sam's knee tap series is here to change your perspective. This one of a kind series has it all! Takedowns, submissions, and so much more!

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1

  • 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu Warm Up System Explained
  • Fundamental Movements
  • Fedor Nikolov Drops In
  • Hip Heist
  • Hip Walk
  • Developing Movements
  • Flip Over


Part 2

  • Name the Move
  • Favorite Leg Lock Defense
  • Propen Sports
  • Key Points
  • Everything Serves a Purpose
  • Knee Tap Armbar
  • Underhook
  • Outro
